---
name: V2 task proposal
about: Propose professional engineering or research work for SWE-Marathon v2
title: "[Task proposal] "
---

## Work and deliverable

What will the agent build or discover, and who would use the result?

## Expertise and workload

Explain the decisions, experiments, and iteration required. Give an initial
workload breakdown toward at least five days of agent execution, aiming for a
week. Include necessary experiment time and identify uncertain estimates.

## Novelty and possible turns

Compare the closest benchmark tasks with source links. Describe meaningful
follow-up requests if useful. A single-turn proposal qualifies only when it
reaches the difficulty and long-horizon bar in the workload section.

## Evidence and feasibility

How will you assess the result? Describe a plausible solution path, data and
licenses, compute, external services, likely shortcuts, and unresolved questions.

## Ownership

State what you intend to work on and where collaboration would help. Link
existing discussions or related PRs.
